projectDescription: A warp-speed AI gateway SDK — written in Rust, available for Rust, Node.js, and Python — that routes chat completion requests across multiple AI providers with a single, unified interface.
keyFeatures: Rust-native core compiled to native binaries for Python and Node.js — minimal overhead latency
Single unified chat completions API across OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, and OpenRouter
provider/model routing strings — switching providers is a one-string change
Streaming chat completions via Server-Sent Events across all SDKs and the HTTP gateway
OpenAI-compatible HTTP gateway — point any OpenAI SDK at it without changing application code
Strict model registry — unknown model names are rejected, never silently misrouted
Configurable request timeout and per-stream read timeout to detect wedged upstreams
Normalized error taxonomy across all providers — DeepSeek 402s surface as OpenAI-compatible 429s
publicApiSurface: Model routing strings: openai/*, deepseek/*, kimi/*, openrouter/*
Error classes: APIError, AuthenticationError, RateLimitError, BadRequestError, InternalServerError, etc.
